about: Forty-two sentences typed at "Who are you?" and the reading each must get from the rules (apps/web/src/lib/start/propose.ts, then start/question.ts). `reads.usecase` is a use case id or none; `reads.modules`, where given, is the exact set installed; `reads.question` is the one question due on the sentence as typed, or null. An `answer` is given to that question and the rest is read after it. A sentence marked `until` names the unit that makes it true and may fail until then; one that passes while still marked is red, so the mark is lifted the day the unit lands.
